sources.presets: Pinned golden cases the Run Simulation dock offers, in menu order. Each id is a sim_run Agent API capability (src/sim_run/agent_capabilities.py); these are the two golden cases the MCP server runs (run_golf_simulator_golden_shot, run_counterfactual_ztcf_golden), so the GUI and the MCP tools execute the same code (#15150 R1).
sources.store_subdir: Folder under the user's data location (QStandardPaths GenericDataLocation, XDG_DATA_HOME on Linux) for the sim_run store; large results spill there as artifacts (payload_bounds.INLINE_PAYLOAD_LIMIT_BYTES). Relative, no '..'.
sources.playable_result_key: Result key naming a results archive (.npz) the explorer can play; when present and the file exists the dock calls load_results(path, wait=False). Neither golden case writes one today, so both show a summary.
sources.summary_max_lines: Most result lines the summary box shows, so a long trajectory never floods the dock.
